question: restaurants within 500 meters of Praça do Comércio
sql:
SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson
FROM lisbon_places
WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant'
  AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(geometry, ST_Point(-9.140, 38.707), 500);

question: building footprints that intersect the Tagus River line
POIs inside Parque das Nações (approx bounding box)
commercial buildings that touch Alfama district boundary (approx polygon)
sql:
SELECT id, class, height
FROM lisbon_buildings
WHERE subtype = 'commercial'
  AND ST_Touches(
        geometry,
        ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.13 38.71, -9.12 38.71, -9.12 38.72, -9.13 38.72, -9.13 38.71))')
      );

question: total residential building area within 1 km of Lisbon airport (approx -9.135,38.775)
historic sites that are contained within any building footprint
sql:
WITH historic AS (
  SELECT id, names.primary AS name, geometry
  FROM lisbon_places
  WHERE taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site'
)
SELECT h.name,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geometry) AS building_geojson
FROM historic h
JOIN lisbon_buildings b
  ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, h.geometry)
LIMIT 10;
